files.architecture.md: Runtime: an external sender submits an HTTPS webhook with a ZIP archive and callback URL. The API records the event in a queue; a worker extracts XML files from the ZIP into storage and fetches the supplied URL. Documents belong to tenants and contain personal data. CI builds the worker with its own credentials; tests use local services. Controls have not been implemented. Signature/replay controls, worker network access and extraction policy are undecided.
